added_comments.text:
# Percent-encode keys and values (spaces -> %20, "&" -> %26, ...) so
# values such as "Smith & Co" cannot corrupt the query string or
# produce a request target that is invalid per RFC 3986.

rationale: The diff fixes the underlying request-encoding defect in _build_url by percent-encoding query params (and path segments in get_export), and removes the FLAKY_ENDPOINTS retry workaround entirely rather than extending it to /v2/exports. The REPORTS_TZ constant and the Bogota local-time behavior for list_reports are untouched. The only added comment explains the non-obvious reason for encoding (RFC 3986 validity, corruption by '&'), so it is a 'why' comment.
